protocol.description: Curve-ecosystem yield and vote aggregator. Users deposit Curve LP tokens; Convex stakes them in Curve gauges and socialises boosted CRV yield. Key surfaces: Booster (deposit routing), cvxCRV (liquid-staked CRV), vlCVX (16-week vote-locked CVX directing Convex's pooled veCRV gauge weight allocation). Extension markets for Frax (cvxFXS/vlCVX), Prisma, and f(x) Protocol.
